snippet.title: Almost Out Of Mana Extended Trailer
snippet.description:
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/almost-out-of-mana/id6757761741
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.crevasse.almostoutofmanagame

Almost Out of Mana is a tactical puzzle game where magical spells, quirky enemies, and limited mana turn every decision into a meaningful choice. Strategically cast spells to defeat every enemy before your mana runs dry.

Why all this careful planning?
A wizard is determined to retrieve his stolen lucky pants.

What to expect?
- Tactical spell-casting puzzle gameplay
- Limited mana forces meaningful decisions.
- Pure tactical gameplay without timers, no rush.
- Distinct enemies with expressive reactions that change how you think.
- A diverse spell-book with distinct mechanics
- Carefully crafted levels of rising difficulty.
- Relaxed pace, focused thinking.
- Hints and game guide available if you get stuck
- Game Center leaderboards, challenges & achievements
- Clean, minimal art with bold, expressive enemies and soundtracks
- Premium: no ads, no tracking, no distractions, no data collected.
- Accessibility features including contrast mode, multiple language support, haptic feedback, and reduced motion

I'm a solo game developer who made this game with lots of care and passion. I hope Almost Out of Mana brings you a little joy, a little challenge and plenty of fun!
